# Roleplay Rule 3 - Every Shift Is Just Another Day
While your character may or may not know that [textlink="Nuclear Operatives" link="NuclearOperatives"], [textlink="Blobs" link="Blob"], and other antagonists exist, they shouldn't be expecting them for no reason. You go into a shift expecting this to be just another day at work.
Remember, [italic]nothing ever happens[/italic], and if something did happen last time, surely it won't happen again! Right?
[textlink="Your character MAY retain knowledge across rounds" link="RuleMetagameOverview"], but they should be starting their shift with the idea that it's been at least a few weeks of nothing happening.
If you are playing a paranoid character, make extra sure you are not [textlink="acting like a vigilante" link="RuleVigilantism"] or [textlink="powergaming" link="RuleMetagamePowergaming"] because of it.
## Precedents
- [color=#1b67a5][bold]Command[/bold][/color] and the [color=#5ed7aa][bold]Station AI[/bold][/color] should not seek to bolt doors to their personal rooms and offices at shift start without a good reason to. - [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] and the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Blueshield Officer[/bold][/color] should not seek to get additional ammo or equipment without a good reason to. - [color=#ba292c][bold]Security[/bold][/color] and [color=#42636d][bold]Paramedics[/bold][/color] should not seek additional departmental access before anything happens.
